environment_reference_bank_structure.entries: Array of environment reference records keyed by environment_id.
environment_reference_bank_structure.entry_fields: environment_id, source_movie, source_scene, source_shot, reference_bank_id, anchor_images, anchor_descriptors, layout_signature, memory_signature, traceability_signature.
environment_reference_bank_structure.indexing: Primary index by environment_id; secondary indexes by source_video_id and layout_signature.

environment_anchor_format.anchor_kind: Anchor classification enum: staircase | table | window | door | railing | architectural_space | environment_anchor.
environment_anchor_format.normalized_position: Vec3 [x,y,z] in screen-normalized space from spatial graph environment_nodes.
environment_anchor_format.importance: Anchor persistence weight in [0,1] derived from EnvironmentAnchorConditioning.
environment_anchor_format.environment_type: Environment type label from RuntimeSpatialGraph environment_nodes.
environment_anchor_format.scene_category: Scene category enum binding anchor to movie scene class.

environment_memory_format.scene_id: Scene identifier binding memory entry to spatial graph scene.
environment_memory_format.environment_anchors: Map of anchor_id to Vec3 position persisted across scenes.
environment_memory_format.location_anchor_reuse: Boolean flag indicating anchor reused from reference bank entry.
environment_memory_format.reference_bank_id: Optional link to environment reference bank record when reused.
environment_memory_format.persistence_score: Cross-scene anchor position stability score in [0,1].

environment_reconstruction_traceability_.traceability_id: Unique traceability record for environment reconstruction lineage.
environment_reconstruction_traceability_.source_video_id: Canonical numerical DNA source identifier (e.g. TITANIC_02).
environment_reconstruction_traceability_.source_scene_id: Full source scene identifier from scene_remap engine.
environment_reconstruction_traceability_.source_shot_id: Full source shot identifier from scene_remap engine.
environment_reconstruction_traceability_.traceability_signature: Deterministic hash binding all lineage fields.

environment_retrieval_strategy.description: Retrieve environment reference bank entry by environment_id first; fall back to layout_signature match against conditioning map export; reuse location anchors via SpatialConsistencyMemory environment_anchors when reference_bank_id is bound.

analysis.environment_identity: Current environment_identity_map is reserved_v1 with preservation_score=0.12; strategy replaces reserved slot with reference bank binding via anchor_images and anchor_descriptors without GPU raster generation.
analysis.environment_reference_bank: Central bank stores per-environment layout, memory, and traceability signatures derived from numerical DNA, scene_remap, and spatial graph anchors; enables IP-Adapter and regional prompting identity recovery.
analysis.location_anchor_reuse: EnvironmentAnchorConstraint anchors from spatial graph map to bank entries; SpatialConsistencyMemory environment_anchors enable cross-scene location_anchor_reuse when reference_bank_id is stable.
analysis.scene_environment_memory: SpatialConsistencyMemoryStore records environment_anchors per scene_id; memory_signature hashes anchor positions for continuity validation across reconstruction shots.
analysis.environment_reconstruction_traceability: traceability_signature binds source_video_id, scene_remap gonegi_scene_id, and conditioning map export path for full lineage audit without backend execution.
